Rooms.Name: Entrance to Gnome Village
Rooms.Description:
You stand on a dusty path that leads east and west. To the east you 
hear the sounds of a small village.  A large forest stands to the north,
and to the south you see a large field.

Rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
Rooms.Description:
This is a path leading into the village. It continues east and west 
and there is a small gnome tavern to the north.

Rooms.Name: A Small Square
Rooms.Description:
This little square is the center of the gnome village. At the center
of the square you see a small fountain filled with water. Roads run 
north and south, an old dusty path leads out of the village to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a dusty path on the far side of the village. Houses are 
to the north and south, while the path continues east. There is a sign 
here.

Rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
Rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the west lies 
the gnome bakery.

Rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
Rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the west you 
see the gnome post office.

Rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
Rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the east you 
can see the gnome magic shop and to the west you can see the gnome 
general store.

Rooms.Name: A Road in the Village
Rooms.Description:
This road runs north and south through the center of the village. 
There are a few people moving around, but not many. To the east you see 
the gnome armor shop and to the west you see the gnome weapon shop.

Rooms.Name: A Small Gnome Tavern
Rooms.Description:
This is a small gnome tavern the walls are made from quality wood. 
You can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity. Along the walls stand large tables filled with 
people eating and drinking. In the north-east corner you see the 
bartender washing some glasses. It is an old gnome not taller than 4 
feet.  Behind him stairs lead up to the private rooms on the second 
floor.

Exits.Description:
The way up is solidly blocked by the bar gnome, who frowns to see you
staring at the stairs.

Rooms.Name: The Bakery
Rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the small bakery. A sweet scent of freshly
baked bread fills the room. The bread is arranged in fine order on the 
shelves, and seems to be of the best quality.

Rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
Rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
Rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Rooms.Name: A Small Gnome House
Rooms.Description:
This is a small suburban house made from quality wood. You 
can see the expert workmanship that went into making it, but it 
lacks creativity.

Rooms.Name: A Gnome General Store
Rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd stuff can be seen all around in the shop.

Rooms.Name: A Gnome Weapon Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd weapons can be seen all around in the shop.

Rooms.Name: A Gnome Armor Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd armors can be seen all around in the shop.

Rooms.Name: Path by a Stream
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path leading north and west that is surrounded 
on the other two sides by a small stream. The water looks mighty cold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.

Rooms.Name: Path by a Stream
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small east-west path. The path shows new grass, as if 
nognome has walked on it recently. A river is to the south, and a small
hut is to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a small hut that is starting to fall apart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The stream is pretty small, but it looks too cold to swim.
The hut looks well built, but it seems to have taken some damage.

Rooms.Name: A Small Hut
Rooms.Description:
The hut is a mess! Blood has stained the grass walls into a dark rich
crimson color. Torn clothes and trash lie all around, and you think you 
see a skeleton in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The skeleton still has a little flesh clinging to it and it is 
definitely humanoid.  The skull has been cracked open, but it is 
otherwise undamaged, except by time.

Rooms.Name: On the Stream
Rooms.Description:
The stream is cold and frigid, yet it supports plenty of life 
beneath its surface. The current trickles west and there is a 
field to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the Stream
Rooms.Description:
The current here flows from the east, but a logjam blocks you from
continuing onward.

Exits.Description: The pool created by the logjam has spread south.

Rooms.Name: The Field of Mice Dreams
Rooms.Description:
This is a large green field of waist high grass. You feel something 
scurry over your feet. There is a cave to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a dark mysterious cave.
The island is bounded by a cold stream to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Cave
Rooms.Description:
The cave gleams as your light reflects off of it. As you squint your 
eyes and try to look ahead, you think you see something move.

Rooms.Name: Darker Cave
Rooms.Description:
The cave gets even darker as your terror grows stronger. You fear 
for your life as something emerges out of the shadows.

Rooms.Name: A Dusty Path
Rooms.Description:
You are on a well traveled path that leads in many directions. To 
the north is a large house, to the west is a fortress and to the east 
lies the fields of training.

Exits.Description: You see a large white house.
You see a large grass field.
You see the gateway to a large fortress.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fortress is a large gnome stronghold to defend the city.

Rooms.Name: The Iron Gateway
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the entrance to the gnome fortress. The place seems to 
be well fortified.

Rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are now inside the fortress; you are lucky that the guards
haven't killed you. As you glance around, you notice that the walls and 
floors are spotlessly clean. The barracks are to the north and a 
storage room is to the south.

Rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are now inside the fortress; you are lucky that the guards
haven't killed you. As you glance around, you notice that the walls 
and floors are spotlessly clean. A mess hall is to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Barracks
Rooms.Description:
You now stand in the sleeping quarters of the gnome guards. Every 
bed is made perfectly, and not a single article of clothing is on 
the floor. There is a small storage room to the east.

Exits.Description: You see a small storage room.

Rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare clothing and armor. 
There is not much here, but you might come up with something.

Rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This is where the gnomes store all their spare weapons. A door leads 
off to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Small Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This is yet another room for storing gnome stuff. Maps and battle 
plans are stored in neat stacks on the shelves.

Rooms.Name: The Mess Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are in the room where the guards come to get their grub. The 
benches and tables are neatly cleaned and straightened, while shiny 
plates line the walls.

Rooms.Name: A Small Room
Rooms.Description:
This is a small plain room. Its only interesting feature is a ladder 
down.

Rooms.Name: A Small Unused Room
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room in an unused section of the fortress. The 
whole room is coated with dust and cobwebs. The ladder leads back up, 
and a rusty door is to the east.

Rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself in a very old section of the fortress. You must be 
the first person to pass through here in years. The hallway continues 
south and a door leads off to the east.

Rooms.Name: Torture Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This is a room that was once used to extract lies out of helpless 
victims. The machines look unused, but could still work.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The machine consists of a large rack with winches on each end.  You can 
almost feel them pulling your arms out of their sockets.

Rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction. The floor is coated 
with some kind of molded slime. Doors lead east and west.

Rooms.Name: Dark Hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hall continues in a north-south direction. The floor is coated 
with some kind of molded slime. Doors lead east and west.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

Rooms.Name: Prison Cell
Rooms.Description:
You are in a dark and nasty prison cell. Bodies lying on the floor 
give off an unbearable stench.

Rooms.Name: End of the Dark Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the end of the dark hallway and maybe the end of 
your puny life. Something lumbers its way out of the shadows.

Rooms.Name: A Ladder
Rooms.Description: You have come into a vertical tunnel with a ladder.

Rooms.Name: Lair
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a new lair in the fortress. Anything could be 
lurking around the corner.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: A Damp Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering in a dark, damp, twisting hallway. The temperature 
seems to be greater here, as well as your fear.

Rooms.Name: The End of the Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You make your way out of the hallway, just to find yourself in 
greater danger. Before you looms the source of the great heat.

Rooms.Name: The Altar
Rooms.Description:
You finally reach the end of the maze. There is a great altar here 
in the shape of a bat. A passageway leads off to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Chief's House
Rooms.Description:
You enter into a large and luxurious house. The floor is coated with 
carpets and the walls are covered in paintings. You feel privileged 
just to be stepping inside.

Rooms.Name: The Unused Path
Rooms.Description:
You are now on a fairly unused path that leads east out of the 
village. You wonder what could be out this way.

Rooms.Name: The Overgrown Path
Rooms.Description:
As the path continues on, the grass grows higher. You can't imagine 
what could possibly be out this way.

Rooms.Name: The Clearing
Rooms.Description:
Your progress is suddenly stopped by mountains on all sides. The 
path leads back to the west, and there appears to be an old mine 
shaft to the north.

Rooms.Name: Cleric's Inner Sanctum
Rooms.Description:
This is the inner sanctum. A picture of the devine Garnak, is 
hanging on the wall, just above the altar which is set against 
the western wall.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Cleric's Guild
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true nature 
of the Clerics. The exit leads east to the field of training. A small 
entrance to the practice yard is in the northern wall.

Rooms.Name: The Field of Training
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a large grass field. To the south you see a stone house 
with a large sign with a sword hanging over the entrance and to the 
east a similar house but with a ancient tome on the sign. The field 
continues to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Field of Training
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a large grass field. To the north you see a stone 
temple and to the east you see an abandoned stone house. The field 
continues to the south.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to Mage's Guild
Rooms.Description: The entrance hall is a small, poor lighted room.

Exits.Description: You see the field of traning.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Laboratory
Rooms.Description:
This is the Magical Experiments Laboratory. Dark smoke-stained 
stones arch over numerous huge oaken tables, most of these cluttered 
with strange-looking pipes and flasks. The floor is covered with 
half-erased pentagrams and even weirder symbols, and a blackboard in 
a dark corner has only been partially cleaned, some painful-looking 
letters faintly visible.

Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Thieves
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the thieves' and assassins' guild. A place 
where you can lose both your life and your money, if you are not 
careful. To the east lies the field of training and if you go down 
you enter the thieves secret yard.

Rooms.Name: The Secret Yard
Rooms.Description:
The secret practice yard of thieves and assassins. Up is the 
entrance the the guild.

Rooms.Name: Entrance Hall to the Guild of Swordsmen
Rooms.Description:
The entrance hall to the Guild of Swordsmen. A place where one has 
to be careful not to say something wrong (or right). To the east is 
the practice yard and to the north is the field of training.

Exits.Description: You see the field of training.

Rooms.Name: The Tournament and Practice Yard
Rooms.Description: The practice yard of the fighters. To the north is the entrance.

Rooms.Name: Log Jam
Rooms.Description:
Ice cold water has pooled up here, blocked by a log jam.  Not the
work of beavers, you see, because there is still room for the water to
seep through between logs.  Still, it has slowed the rushing current
enough for the water to rise up to your waist (if you're a fairy, you're
probably drowning).

Exits.Description: Cold water leads to a narrow embankment.
Upstream the water becomes more shallow.

Rooms.Name: MidStream
Rooms.Description:
Standing in a bit of cold water moving slowly at you from the east,
where you can see a waterfall in the far distance, it might occur to you
that getting OUT of the water would be good for your health.  Your
choices are then north to a small island run rampant with mice, or south
east towards a beach area.

Exits.Description: A small troop of mice seem to be ... chortling!
This is the upstream direction of the water ...

The stream is wide at this point, but you can see a beach area southeast
of here.
The stream pools up in front of some logs to the west of here.

Rooms.Name: MidStream
Rooms.Description:
The cold rushing waters of a mountain fed stream are remarkably clear
all around you.  The streambed is rocky and uncomfortable beneath your
feet, but the rapidly moving water at least ensures it is not too
slippery.  To the east you can hear a waterfall.  To the south a tall
cliff looms over you.  Not a good time for an earthquake!

Exits.Description: In the near distance you can hear the sounds of a waterfall.
Beyond just a bit more stream lies a sunny gnomish picnic beach.

Rooms.Name: Nearing the Falls
Rooms.Description:
There's just something about falling water that enchants the soul of
even the most severely cranky gnome.  You can hear the pounding of water
hitting rock just to the east of here, and in the daytime the sight is
quite awesome.  You are wide awake no matter what the time of day or
night, of course, because you are standing in rapidly moving, frigid
water.

Exits.Description: A steep cliff combines with snowmelt to make an impressive waterfall.

The small stream moves rapidly westwards, swerving around a small
island.

Rooms.Name: Waterfalls
Rooms.Description:
From high above you a narrow but steady stream of water falls in a
frothy gush down to clean rocks where you stand.  The water falls
thinly, but with a great deal of force due to the height of the cliff
from which it falls.

Exits.Description:
It would be definitely safer for you to head downstream from here.
Besides, it's your only choice.

Rooms.Name: At a Wide Spot in a Stream
Rooms.Description:
The water is barely deep enough here to drown in standing up, but it
is quite cold and so you understand why the gnomes cross in boats rather
than simply wading through.  To the north you can see a small island
filled with mice and old Trollish loincloths.  To the southeast lie the
Gnomish Picnic Grounds.

Exits.Description: The stream really is quite wide at this point.
Just up ahead and slightly south lies a beach.

Rooms.Name: By the Beach
Rooms.Description:
The water is shallower here, and a trifle warmer.  The ground beneath
your feet has changed from rocky to a sandy-silt, soft enough to make
you want to take off your shoes and dig in your toes, and soft enough to
make walking across it pull at your calf muscles.  The beach is south of
here, full of small changing tents and the normal detritus of picnics
long past.

Exits.Description: The stream gets much deeper to the north.

Rooms.Name: Beach Blanket Babylon
Rooms.Description:
Gaily striped tents strongly resembling tiny circus tents dot this
tiny beach.  Blankets in more subdued colors are stretched here and
there for a gnomish family picnic and barbecue.  The area is protected
by the tall cliff to the south, the only really open area being the
inviting (if freezing) stream to the north.

Exits.Description: A shallow embankment leads to a cold stream, suitable for wading.

As you look more closely at the steep cliff behind you, you note that it
IS climbable.

Rooms.Name: Steep cliff
Rooms.Description:
Rocky and so steep it would give a mountain goat second thoughts
about climbing, the narrow path makes its way up the treacherous slope,
it's only saving grace being the many rocky outcroppings you may grasp
to keep yourself from falling down.   W-a-y-y-y down.

Exits.Description: The path up the cliff face heads east around some rocks.

Rooms.Name: Path up a Steep Cliff
Rooms.Description:
Here and there this rocky cliff is impossibly dotted with small scrub
brush growing out of cracks in the rock face.  You know that eventually
the hardy vegetation will crumble the mighty cliff, widening cracks and
leaving it vulnerable to the ravages of time and weather.  For now, you
simply wonder if it is hardy enough to bear your weight.

Exits.Description:
The path down is fraught with danger, but still possible.  The path up
is almost sheer rock.
The footholds in the rock lead you up the face of the cliff.

Rooms.Name: Clinging to the Cliff
Rooms.Description:
In places, the rock is quite brittle, crumbling to gravel beneath
your searching boot, and in others it is so smooth that your hands are
unable to find a place to hold.  Your muscles should ache, but the
adrenalin rushing through your veins is keeping you from feeling the
pain.  You have two choices from here.  Up ...  or down.

Exits.Description:
There is a last sheer stretch of rock before you come to the top of this
cliff.

It is a L-O-N-G way down from here.  But then, it is a long way up as
well.  Neither direction looks safe.  But if you were looking for
safety, why would you be here?

Rooms.Name: Just Down from a Cliff Top
Rooms.Description:
Grab the edge of the ledge above you and pull yourself up and over,
onto the edge of the cliff.  Even if you thought you were on your way
down, the safe thing to do is climb up and over and find another way
back.  It's a L-O-N-G way down from here, and the beach at the bottom of
the cliff may be soft, but nothing would be soft enough to keep you from
certain death if you fell.

Exits.Description: That's it! Just an arm's reach from here.
It's a LONG way down from here.

Rooms.Name: On Top of a High Cliff, Looking Down
Rooms.Description:
The view from here is breathtaking.  To the north, across a small
stream and down a steep cliff you can see a tiny village of gnomes.  To
the very distant north you see the thick forests of the magic elf
kingdom of Tynstri.

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Well-Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path has been beaten into the wild grasses of this
rolling plateau.  It stretches raggedly in an east-west direction,
seemingly meandering without purpose.

Exits.Description: The narrow little path stops abruptly at a clifftop.

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Well-Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
At this "Y" intersection in the path, the main track of the path
heads eastwards, while a small trail of trampled grasses would seem to
lead to the southwest.  The shape of the intersection may help to remind
you of the name of those beasties you see in the distance.

Exits.Description: The well beaten path continues east for a stretch.

A small narrow path has been recently trampled into existence by some
very heavy animal.
The well beaten path continues west for a stretch.

Rooms.Name: Drop It!
Rooms.Description:
Someone must have taught the beasties well not to leave their
droppings in their barn, for they have left them all over this trail.
Careful where you put your foot, or you'll not be welcome anywhere you
go (except a yak convention, of course).

Exits.Description: The path continues in its monotonous way.

Rooms.Name: An Intersection in the Meadow
Rooms.Description:
What looks like the main path curves here from east to north, and
then curves again.  To the south, the grasses have been recently
trampled into submission, so if you follow this particular trail you are
bound to run into something that runs around on 4 cloven hooves.

Exits.Description: A well beaten if somewhat quirky path runs north of here.
A well beaten if somewhat quirky path runs east of here.
A recently trampled dent in the meadow grasses leads south.

Rooms.Name: A Very Curvy Path
Rooms.Description:
This path seems to wander unnecessarily through the thick meadow
grasses on the high plateau.  You have little opportunity to admire the
beautiful purple mountains to the northeast because you need to keep
watching for the long pointed yaks and their leavings.  This path twists
west and south at this point.

Exits.Description: The path curves around to the south.
The path curves towards where the sun sets.

Rooms.Name: A Very Curvy Path
Rooms.Description:
The curvy meadow path twists through tall, thick meadow grasses.
Whatever the yaks eat, it apparently isn't this grass.  They have the
look of their vegetarian kindred, but you wonder if, perhaps, they eat
people instead.  The certainly have the built in weaponry to kill
anything they please.  Those horns are really wicked.

Exits.Description: The path curves around to the north.
The path curves around to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Gnome Magic Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are in one of the several shops of this fine town. The wares 
look fine. Lots of odd magic devices can be seen all around in the 
shop.

Rooms.Name: The Post Office
Rooms.Description:
You are in the post office in Gnome village. Piles of assorted mail
lay untouched in the corners, collecting cobwebs. Several large crates 
have been pried open by curious customs agents, and are now stacked 
along the west wall, hiding plenty of 'WANTED' posters. There is a sign
posted on the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
**********************************************************
*                                                        *
*    Mail Instructions :                                 *
*                                                        *
*      To send a note to someone :                       *
*         MAIL <playername>                              *
*                                                        *
*      To see if you have any mail :                     *
*         CHECK                                          *
*                                                        *
*      To get the Postmaster to give you your mail :     *
*         RECEIVE                                        *
*                                                        *
*         Stamps cost 350 coins per letter               *
*         Type 'HELP MAIL' for more info                 *
**********************************************************
They seem to cover everything here, even the Postmaster himself.

As you know, it is illegal to send contraband items through the 
Midgaard mail. The custom's agents use this as a great excuse to seize
liquor, rare spices, pornography, and just about anything they might 
find useful or profitable.

Faces of various known Player Killers and Player Thieves can barely be
seen behind the crates on the west wall. Some of them look quite 
familar, sorta like that guy who you saw in the Reception a minute ago.
But then again, they are rather hard to see past the crates.

Rooms.Name: Nearby the Big Red Barn
Rooms.Description:
You are standing near the edge of a wide rolling meadow that
stretches out to the north and west for quite a long distance.  Here and
there the meadow is dotted by the wide curling horns of the yak, raised
here by the gnomes.  The gnomes treat them almost as pets, and the yaks
in turn protect the physically weak gnomes.

Exits.Description: A short path through yak-filled meadows leads to a big red barn.
A curvy little path through the meadow grasses begins here.

Rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
The little yak path gets even littler here, as the grass seems to
spring up behind you as you walk through it, following whatever went
before you.  The main path lies north of here, this little tributary
runs east.

Exits.Description:
A slightly wider path is just this way.  Looking further you see the
beautiful mountains to the northeast.

Rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
Whatever wandered off in this direction apparently kept on going
south, for the track of the large animal head from east to south through
here.  Although the grass is tall here, unless you are a very young
gnome or halfling, you can see over them to the many yaks peacefully
filling their bellies and the beautiful mountains to the north.

Rooms.Name: Where Many Hooves Converge
Rooms.Description:
Two narrow, recently beaten paths converge at this point, one coming
from the north, the other from the east, and both seem to be headed
west.  If you are tracking something, then, that would seem to be the
way to go.

Exits.Description:
Something large ventured from that direction.  In the words of Pooh
(hunting Heffalumps), "You see where he's going to and I'll see where he
came from!

Something large ventured from that direction.  In the words of Pooh
(hunting Heffalumps), "You see where he's going to and I'll see where he
came from!
In the Presence of The Yak

Rooms.Name: YakkityYak (Don't Look Back!)
Rooms.Description:
THE yak tends to hang out here.  His yak harem brings him presents of
the most delicate of meadow flowers, and the gnomes weave them into
garlands to wear about his mighty neck or decorate his serious horns.
Should he become hungry, they are a delicate appetizer, a "starter" to a
more interesting meal of ... say ... adventurer?

Rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
A faint trail leads off the main path just north of here.  At this
point it twists to the west.  You are standing in a meadow lushly
planted with thick, tall grasses, some of them flowering in many
different colors.  This trail continues west.

Exits.Description: The main path is north of here.

Rooms.Name: Off the Beaten Path
Rooms.Description:
A very narrow path has been recently trod by a heavy, wide animal
headed east from where you are standing.  The tracks at your feet are
fresh, the trampled meadow grasses still bleeding grassjuice.  Above the
grasses, knee high for a human at this point, you can see a large number
of yaks wandering about the meadow.

Exits.Description:
Whatever made this little trail (and for some reason a yak springs to
mind), it was headed west.

Mobs.Name: child gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome child is playing around here.
Mobs.Description:
The little tyke looks so innocent playing with his boomerang that you 
just want to pick him up and hug him.

Mobs.Name: woman gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful gnome woman is standing here, looking for somebody.
Mobs.Description:
The woman is short and gnarled, but acts like a woman several times her
beauty. She's starting to look pretty attractive to you ...

Mobs.Name: man gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome man is walking, on his way to work.
Mobs.Description:
This is a prime example of a gnome.  He looks short and weak, but at the
same time an intelligent creature who could outsmart you.

Mobs.Name: gnome armourer
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome armourer wanders around deep in thought.
Mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

Mobs.Name: guard gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome guard looks fiercely at you, not sure whether to let you pass.
Mobs.Description:
This is a well trained gnome.  He might not have a lot of strength but
he makes up for it with his weapons skill.

Mobs.Name: chief gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A powerful looking gnome stands here wearing ornate clothes.
Mobs.Description:
The Chief looks like he could whap you hard.  He looks not only powerful
but wise and resourceful.  You better not mess with him.

Mobs.Name: troll small
Mobs.LongDescription: A small troll grunts as he takes a swing at you.
Mobs.Description:
The small troll is a short and stocky beast with a human-like face
but with the eyes and fangs of a wild beast.

Mobs.Name: mouse field
Mobs.LongDescription: A small mouse wonders, "If I build it, will they come?"
Mobs.Description: The Mouse is a cute little creature.

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: A small rat shrieks and runs around.
Mobs.Description: The rat is a little evil creature that deserves death.

Mobs.Name: rat large
Mobs.LongDescription: A large rat runs up to you and nibbles on your boots.
Mobs.Description: You have the urge to kill this vile creature.

Mobs.Name: rat giant
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant rat growls at you and prepares to attack.
Mobs.Description: This rat has grown up to be the size of an average dog.

Mobs.Name: troll
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant troll lumbers around.
Mobs.Description:
You see before you a huge mass of living flesh.  You cringe in fear as
he lifts his powerful arm to bludgeon you.

Mobs.Name: bat black
Mobs.LongDescription: A black bat hangs from the ceiling.
Mobs.Description: The bat is a grotesque little creature with large wings and fangs.

Mobs.Name: zombie gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: A zombie gnome shuffles his way towards you.
Mobs.Description:
This is a creature which has passed away long ago.  His body has been
pulled out of its resting place by some evil force.

Mobs.Name: bat fire
Mobs.LongDescription: The fire bat flames brightly and prepares to attack.
Mobs.Description:
You see a huge flame which resembles the shape of a bat.  The creature
hangs from the ceiling and bites at you.

Mobs.Name: gnome weaponsmith
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome weaponsmith wanders around deep in thought.
Mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

Mobs.Name: gnome storekeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome storekeeper wanders around deep in thought.
Mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

Mobs.Name: gnome scientist
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome scientist wanders around deep in thought.
Mobs.Description:
You see a gnome who is lost deep into some invention that he is about
to make. His hair is white, but he looks fairly strong.

Mobs.Name: gnome tavernkeeper
Mobs.LongDescription: A gnome tavernkeeper stands here deep in thought.
Mobs.Description:
This gnome has seen many winters, his beard is grey and his face
scarred. He looks very friendly though.

Mobs.Name: baker
Mobs.LongDescription: The Baker looks at you calmly, wiping flour from his face with one hand.
Mobs.Description:
A fat, nice looking baker. But you can see that he has many scars on his
body.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: The ancient gnomish mage has eyes that seem to see right through you.
Mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: The ancient priestess prepares herself to teach yet another generation.
Mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: The ancient assassin still knows a trick or two more than you do.
Mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge she possesses.  She is wearing fine magic
clothing, and you notice that she is surrounded by a blue shimmering aura.

Mobs.Name: guildmaster master
Mobs.LongDescription: The esteemed General will help you learn the secret art of gnomish warfare.
Mobs.Description:
Even though your guildmaster looks old and tired, you can clearly see the
vast amount of knowledge he possesses.  He is wearing a uniform of the
Gnomish Imperial Guard (GIG), and he has been much decorated.

Mobs.Name: yak
Mobs.LongDescription:
The yak wanders aimlessly through the meadows in search of the perfect
flower.
Mobs.Description:
Tall and mighty enough not to fret much about strangers in her environment,
the yak spends much of her time grazing in the sweet meadow grasses that
are a feature of this plateau.  As she grazes, she looks for pretty flowers
to bring to her lover, THE yak.

Mobs.Name: gnome ancient old yakherder
Mobs.LongDescription: The extremely ancient, nearly decrepit old gnome watches out over his yaks.
Mobs.Description:
Actually, of course, it is the yaks who watch out over this ancient gnome.
They are very protective of the old man, and have secretly gifted him with
many protective spells.  He has been with them almost since his birth and
has long since become a bit daft.

Mobs.Name: yak Yakkity-yak yakkity
Mobs.LongDescription: Yakkity yak likes to bask in the sunshine and the adoration of his harem.
Mobs.Description:
Known to the others of his clan as simply "THE yak", Yakkity is a yak in
the prime of his life.  He has a hornspan that is the envy of every other
male yak, and the twirling curve of each horn is graceful beyond
expectation.

Mobs.Name: dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: High overhead a dragon lazily circles, waiting for the grasses to dry.
Mobs.Description:
The mischievous dragon is looking forward to late autumn, when the summer
sun will have turned the sweet grasses to dry hay, and a little fire
artfully applied will turn the meadow into a spectacular display.  Sorry
little dragon, this is an enchanted meadow, and will be forever green and
juicy.

Mobs.Name: apprentice yakherder
Mobs.LongDescription: The apprentice yakherder is just learning how to yak.
Mobs.Description:
He's become very good at polishing horns, however.  The young gnome studied
yak husbandry at college and came home to tend the clan yak farm.  He has
become very attached to his yaks, now, and does most of the actual work of
caring for them.

Mobs.Name: yolanda yak
Mobs.LongDescription: Yolanda Yak floats lightly over the meadowflowers.
Mobs.Description:
An unfortunate accident of birth, cursed by a wicked fairy, Yolanda was
born with a horrible disfiguration.  On her back she has grown a pair of
wings.  Now, Yolanda is a substantial-sized yak, so she cannot simply fly
off, but she is pleased not to bruise the flowers she does not eat.

Mobs.Name: yvan yak
Mobs.LongDescription:
Yvan Yak stretches his mighty head w-a-y down to munch some sweet
meadowgrass.
Mobs.Description:
Although the meadowgrass on the plateau grows quite tall, unfortunately so
did Yvan.  It is difficult for him to get his fill of the grass without
sitting down to reach it.  Since a yak must protect his pride, and since a
yak also looks pretty silly sitting down, Yvan goes hungry way too often.

Mobs.Name: bigmama yak
Mobs.LongDescription: BigMama yak IS the mother of all yaks.
Mobs.Description:
BigMama is a mighty fine female yak.  Powerful muscles ripple visibly
beneath a smooth glossy black coat of longish fur.  Her horns gleam
brightly, polished daily by her gnome.  Mother of All Yaks, she is truly
magnificent.

Mobs.Name: yseult yak
Mobs.LongDescription: Yseult slinks sexily through the softly caressing grasses.
Mobs.Description:
Yseult knows herself to be the favorite of THE yak, and feels even the
meadow grasses bow down to her beauty.  She sways through the grasses,
giving her yakkish hips a slight wiggle.

Mobs.Name: veerle gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: Veerle sunbathes in her teenie weenie bikini.
Mobs.Description:
Long blond hair streaming out behind her, well annointed with oil, 
Veerle is the very picture of summer abandon.  Having spent the winter 
months in exercise and close attention to her diet, she radiates 
self-confidence, and has already attracted the attention of several 
tall gnomish musclemen.

Mobs.Name: swimmer
Mobs.LongDescription: The swimmer's slightly blue skin is covered with tiny bumps from the cold.
Mobs.Description:
The young gnome is quite athletic, and determined to play his part in the
Clan Olympics this year.  He trains daily, swimming continually upstream in
this frigid little stream.

Mobs.Name: mouse field
Mobs.LongDescription: The little mouse chortles merrily at the trick he will play on Mr. Troll.
Mobs.Description: The Mouse is a cute little rodent, similar to a Rat.

Mobs.Name: gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: The pot-bellied gnome adds driftwood to his fire to cook his fish.
Mobs.Description:
This gnome is aging, but clearly still active.  He has a habit of 
guzzling brew each night (and all day Saturday) and that and time have 
added an unwanted curve to his otherwise fit self.  He enjoys coming 
down to the river beach to fish with his son, who loves to swim.

Mobs.Name: climber gnome
Mobs.LongDescription: The gnome may be small, but his wiry strength makes him a good climber.
Mobs.Description:
Toes braced in crevices too small for human feet, clinging to bushes too
fragile to hold a troll's hat, the gnome bravely makes his way up the
mountain.

Mobs.Name: frog
Mobs.LongDescription: A lonely frog hops from lily pad to lily pad, wishing he were a prince.
Mobs.Description:
r-r-r-r-i-b-b-b-b-i-t-t-t-t! The frog's been looking everywhere for a
little crown, not so he can get kissed by some human female, but so someone
will believe that he's really a prince of a fellow and reward him with lots
of nice juicy flies and some really fine female frogs.

Objects.Name: key bloody
Objects.Description: A bloody key is stuck to the floor.

Objects.Name: key dirty
Objects.Description: A dirty key lies here.

Objects.Name: toy boomerang
Objects.Description: A toy boomerang wants to be picked up.

Objects.Name: staff gnarled
Objects.Description: A gnarled staff is here.

Objects.Name: sword gnome
Objects.Description: A gnome sword catches your eye.

Objects.Name: shield studded
Objects.Description: A studded wooden shield lies here.

Objects.Name: potion bloody
Objects.Description: A bloody potion lies here.

Objects.Name: cloak bloody
Objects.Description: A bloody cloak lies in a corner.

Objects.Name: ring bat
Objects.Description: A ring in the shape of a bat lies here.

Objects.Name: necklace bead
Objects.Description: A string of beads is here.

Objects.Name: sword electrum
Objects.Description: An electrum sword lies here.

Objects.Name: peanuts
Objects.Description: Peanuts lie here.

Objects.Name: boots gnome
Objects.Description: You notice a pair of Gnome Boots.

Objects.Name: coins
Objects.Description: A pile of coins.

Objects.Name: coins
Objects.Description: A pile of coins.

Objects.Name: bread gnome
Objects.Description: A delicous bread is laying here.

Objects.Name: Cornbread
Objects.Description: A cornbread lies here.

Objects.Name: banana
Objects.Description: There is a banana here.

Objects.Name: dagger long
Objects.Description: A long dagger is laying here.

Objects.Name: belt
Objects.Description: A strange looking leather belt lies here.

Objects.Name: gloves sturdy
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of sturdy leather gloves
Objects.Description: A sturdy pair of leather gloves lies here.

Objects.Name: sack
Objects.Description: A large sack lies.

Objects.Name: lantern hooded
Objects.Description: A hooded lantern lies here.

Objects.Name: Wand of missiles
Objects.Description: a strange wand is laying here.

Objects.Name: scroll
Objects.Description: A old dust scroll lies forgoten here.

Objects.Name: Barrel
Objects.Description: A barrel stand here on the ground.

Objects.Name: Beer
Objects.Description: A glass with beer stands here.

Objects.Name: bottle
Objects.Description: A bottle is standing here.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A small fountain filled with water stands in the middle of the square.

Objects.Name: yakherder hat
Objects.Description: The many shades of green knitted into this cap say "Come hither" to a yak.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Granny Higglebottom in Stanneg knits these special caps for the gnomish
yakherders from fine, soft wool.  It has a little added "something" from
the magic of her hands.  The colors she has used are many different
shades of grasses found on the yak plateau, and because of this the yaks
are very attracted to the wearer of the hat.  It is a long, narrow tube,
tapering to a point at one end.

Objects.Name: bikini
Objects.Description: It was an itsy bitsy teensy weensy yellow polka dot bikini that she wore.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It was an itsy bitsy teensy weensy yellow polka dot bikini ...

Objects.Name: potion levitating
Objects.Description: This potion is given to graduates of the Gnomish Mountaineer Academy.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In case of emergencies, such as an imminent event that involves
plummeting to the ground at a very high speed, this potion is to be quaffed,
IMMEDIATELY.  A small disclaimer is put at the bottom: "Not to be used in any
other purpose than specified by license agreement. Using this potion for any
actions involving scrounging cookies is strictly forbidden.

Objects.Name: polish
Objects.ShortDescription: a jar of yak horn polish
Objects.Description: There is nothing so beautiful as a well-polished yak horn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stimulation of being rubbed and the tingle of the herbs in this polish
help the yak's horns to grow strong and straight and quite hard. The polish,
of Elven origin and purchased from the halfling traders, has a very pleasant
odor, and the yaks seem to greatly enjoy the polishing.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka wolf werewolf
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a wolf
Objects.Description: The very small werewolf looks ready to bite you.  Bite it first!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small gingerbread werewolf is no real threat to you.  It is spicy and
sweet at the same time.  Very tasty!

Objects.Name: pepparkaka cookie gingerbread dragon
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a dragon
Objects.Description: The little dragon looks very hot!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Baked of spicy gingergread then carefully decorated, the little cookie looks
very much like a real dragon ... only smaller!  With those giant wings, it
might just take off and fly, so you'd better bite it quickly.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka gnome
Objects.ShortDescription: a pepparkaka cookie shaped like a gnome
Objects.Description: A little gnome wiggles her gingerbread ears at you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Actually, if you look closely at this little gnome you can see that the Mind-
Bogglingly Magnificent Nell insisted on posing for the gingerbread cookie mold
that this cookie popped out of.  And of course, she is wearing her trademark
rainbow cape.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka elf superelf
Objects.Description:
All little boys, except the Trollish ones, want to be
superheroes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With the very nicely pointed ears and the magnificent cape, this could be none
other than the Elfking himself.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka angel angelic
Objects.Description: A very angelic-looking cookie flies by on sugar wings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The little gingerbread angel has a #ws#Yp#wa#Yr#wk#Yl#wi#Yn#Wg
#y*halo*#N on its head.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka balloon
Objects.Description: This cookie is lighter than air and might float away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A hot air balloon with a little picnic basket bottom and brightly colored
(iced) silks.  The picnic basket looks large enough for a small troop of
gnomes, complete with picnic!

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka glob
Objects.ShortDescription: a globby mess of a pepparkaka
Objects.Description: A slightly soggy underbaked sunken glob of cookie is still lip smackin!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Apparently this is one of Jilly's few failures and yet, she is very pleased
with this particular cookie.  It is a large, amorphous glob of a cookie, looks
slightly wet and (and I know this is very strange), it radiates an evil aura.
Stamped on the underside (the slightly flatter side) of the cookie you can see
the words in Old Gnomish, "Property of Glob, Inc".

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
Objects.Description: A little dirt on the viking pepparkaka makes him just look more real.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
With its blue sugar crystal eyes and toasty marshmallow hair, this gingerbread
cookie makes your mouth water despite the fact it's managed to roll a bit in
the dirt.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka troll
Objects.Description: The HUGE pepparkaka looks very thick and warty.  Must be trollish!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The features on this HUGE pepparkaka troll are slightly out of proportion, and
someone has put a tiny currant wart on his bulbous nose. He was a bit thicker
than the other cookies, so he may not be baked all the way through.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka fairy
Objects.Description: The fairy pepparkaka has white icing-wings and a licorice wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Barely a mouthful of gingerbread makes up this tiny melt-in-your-mouth spicy
sweet cookie.

Objects.Name: cookie gingerbread pepparkaka viking
Objects.Description: This #wViking#G pepparkaka looks like he has been rolling in the dirt!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although this pepparkaka #wViking#N looks fierce, he is spicy
and sweet.  Well equipped with candy axe and hammer, the cookie Viking's
pale blond yellow-icing hair streaks out from beneath his conical helmet.
